attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation and kept to the cold brief’s allowed material. I viewed native-resolution crops from all 706 PNGs, covering 194 first screens, 492 scroll frames, and 20 runtime frames across both themes and the available viewport sizes. I used visible-text extraction and the accessibility trees across the matrix and runtime captures to cross-check wording, and opened larger original-resolution areas to verify cited evidence. The visual batches covered selected areas of each frame. I encountered no earlier audit reference, saved no friction notes, and started no browser or daemon.

findings.surface: Kitchen › task details › Project name
repro: 3. Open the task details for Choose appliance finishes.
findings.expected: Project identifies the owning place by its display name, Kitchen.
findings.actual: The Project value reads “project-kitchen”. The other drawer capture also uses an ID, “project-client-migration”.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world

findings.surface: Kitchen › task details › Status
repro: 3. Open the task details for Choose appliance finishes.
findings.expected: Task state uses the same readable labels as the project's Todos page.
findings.actual: Status reads “todo” in Kitchen and “done” in Client migration. Todos uses “To do” and “Done” for those states.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world

findings.surface: Kitchen › task details › Estimate

findings.expected: The field communicates the unit of the task estimate before a number is entered.
findings.actual: The field label is only “Estimate”. The field supplies no hint that the Progress section refers to the same values as “estimate points”.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world

findings.surface: Home renovation › Reflections › Write a reflection › title
repro: 2. Open Home renovation and select Reflections.
3. Read the field label just below Write a reflection.
findings.expected: The field has a persistent visible label that identifies what to type.
